name: Blueberry Blossom Farm (formerly Blue Heron Blueberries)
description: Blueberry Blossom Farm (formerly Blue Heron Blueberries) is an agritourism farm in 8628 Fobes Road, WA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
